package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Available Themes

Install the theme package you want with `npm install @astryxdesign/theme-<name>`, then import its slug with `theme add <slug>`. The CLI imports the package's built outputs for you.

Theme     | Add command                                      | Description                                                                   
--------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Neutral   | `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add neutral` | Muted, minimal aesthetic with Figtree typography. A good starting point.      
Butter    | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add butter    | Golden, buttery surfaces with blue accents; Sarina + Outfit type.             
Chocolate | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add chocolate | Warm brown tones and cozy beige; Fraunces + Albert Sans type.                 
Gothic    | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add gothic    | Dark-only atmospheric theme; deep blue-gray surfaces, distressed display type.
Matcha    | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add matcha    | Earthy greens; DM Sans + Playwrite US Trad type.                              
Stone     | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add stone     | Warm stone and slate tones; Montserrat + Figtree type.                        
Y2K       | npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add y2k       | Playful Y2K pop; periwinkle body, holographic accents, Poppins + Crimson Text.

Every first-party package exports its built theme at `@astryxdesign/theme-{name}/built`, production CSS at `/theme.css`, and font loading CSS at `/fonts.css`. `theme add` writes those imports into the generated app module.
